hero.description: Hi, I'm Donya Mardani — a software engineer specializing in React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I build fast, scalable web applications with clean, maintainable code and a strong focus on user experience.

about.p1: I'm a passionate software engineer with over 2 years of experience building digital products that aim to make a real impact. My journey started with a curiosity about how the web works and has evolved into a strong focus on modern frontend technologies.
about.p2: I specialize in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, building everything from polished landing pages to complex web applications. My approach combines technical excellence with a strong eye for design and user experience.
about.quote: My mission is to create digital experiences that are not only functional, but genuinely enjoyable — products that are easy for users to navigate and easy for developers to maintain.
